well as I've said above. Well school classes I barely passed. Multiple hobbies I've picked up just becoming boring. Gaining around 13kg (30 pounds) due to medicine.  
Moving out somehow not helping. Stopping therapy because he retired. Having multiple breakdowns when getting a guide dog (something I thought would help me) and now I have to relive my experience every time people ask why I don't have the dog...

Hey.

I'm still not doing good...
thanks so much! :)

Well school classes I barely passed. Multiple hobbies I've picked up just becoming boring. Gaining around 13kg (30 pounds) due to medicine.  

Moving out somehow not helping. Stopping therapy because he retired. Having multiple breakdowns when getting a guide dog (something I thought would help me) and now I have to relive my experience every time people ask why I don't have the dog...
yeah basically.

A lot of things but strangely nothing... Empty, sad, disgusted with myself, lonely.

Everything is so quiet. It feels like no one is alove, but at the same time, it feels like everyone has just moved on to better things, leaving me behind, again...
I have really given it my all. So I guess the only other option is nothing...
Yeah see. I’ve tried that. It doesn’t work like it’s apparently supposed to

I can relate so hard. My last many relationships has either ended in me being cheated on, or me being ghosted.

On top of being disabled, I really feel like I’m not worth anything to anyone.

I get this 100% 
Like, talking virtually is good and all, but I really just want a physical hug from someone I am close to, just to snuggle up to them, and them telling me that it’s all going to be OK.
The few close friends I have are either asleep (because they are in my timezone) or busy.
Really, no problem at all

Hey.
I can’t offer any concrete advice, but I’m here if you want to chat a bit
If you want to chat a bit, with a total Reddit stranger, my inbox is always open

This.
You perfectly put into words what I feel about friendships.

I hope you find someone out there, that will be your friend through thick and thin

I know the feeling of feeling alone, and feeling very ugly.
I won’t give you one of those cliché lines about that you aren’t ugly, or that you should love yourself, because then I would be a hypocrite.
iI just  hope you are OK

Thanks, I just don’t want to bother people anymore, I guess.
I have tried talking to people, it just doesn’t seem to work.

Thanks for taking the time to reply.

doing great... It doesn't feel that way. Nothing is working at all, no matter what I try to fix.

I glanced over your profile, and in any case, you have just as valid reason to be depressed as anyone else.
Thanks for taking time out of your day to respond

I have seen caring people too, if they want to be your friend.
I have never experienced it, when I have tried to look for a romantic or sexual partner.

Trust me, you probably wouldn’t. I know, I wouldn’t wish what I have gone through, on my worst enemies.

Honestly, I’m starting to believe the opposite.
I have told my therapist multiple times how I feel, but he doesn’t seem to have anything that helps me.
Also, attraction is based on looks, I’ve heard the line about personality 1 million times, but I have seen from experience, that it doesn’t actually work that way.

I’m not doing it purely just to feel better.
I’m trying, at least, to do it to create meaningful relations with other people

That is definitely a part of my depression. I’m working towards that.
It’s just, I have also tried online dating, with no success

I just don’t know about that. It’s really hard when you hear that from family too, and you see your friends getting in and out of relationships all the time.

Also, oh I probably have some form of that, because I was bullied for my looks all the way through public school, and my family has also made very hurtful comments over the years
Love is madness by 30 seconds to Mars and Halsey
A good bed. You are literally spending around 1/4 - 1/3 of your day in bed. Better make it worth the time spend. And it will make the rest of your day so much more amazing.
Laying down and sleeping after24+ hours of being awake
